title: Thingiverse - Cale de haut-parleur arrière Porsche 993
notes: Un index secondaire identifie ce fichier Thingiverse comme une cale pour haut-parleurs arriere de Porsche 993, concue pour que la grille d'origine se clipse sur le modele; il indique un STL gratuit, mais renvoie la licence a la page primaire. La page Thingiverse n'a pas ete relue dans cette campagne et aucune cote, mesure, variante audio, photo de montage independante ou licence exploitable n'est verifiee. Piste CAO non critique a recuperer legalement puis comparer a l'ouverture et aux fixations reelles; ne pas copier le mesh dans le depot. 2026-10-15: the original Thingiverse page (thing 3752304) was not read: www.thingiverse.com served its robots.txt behind a Cloudflare bot challenge (HTTP 403, 'Just a moment...') to both the page-reading tool and a plain HTTP client, so permission for automated agents could not be established and the thing page was not requested. The Internet Archive index lists a capture of that page dated 2022-01-09 (HTTP 200); it was not read, because the page-reading tool refuses web.archive.org. Licence, author, units and dimensions remain unverified; redistribution stays unknown. 2026-11-07: the live primary page https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:3752304 was read in an ordinary browser without login or challenge bypass. Its explicit licence link confirms CC-BY-4.0. See docs/research/thingiverse-secondary-batch-20261107.md for author, filenames, declared application and limits. This supersedes the earlier licence conclusion without deleting historical notes. No file was downloaded or imported, and no dimensional or functional claim was independently verified. Existing safety-review restrictions remain. Secondary-page access dates are unchanged because those pages were not reread.
